name.label: Event name
name.hint: Automatically filled based on the selected event type.

schedule.label: Date and time
schedule.hint: Choose the planned date and preferred time window.

location.label: Location
location.hint: Choose the address or venue for directions and navigation.

dressCode.label: Dress Code
dressCode.hint: The chosen dress code is used to set guest expectations.

description.label: Description / Wishes
description.hint: Add a short description or wishes to prepare your guests for the event.
description.placeholder: Please join us to celebrate the most important day of our lives.

additional.label: Additional details
additional.hint: Add extra information guests will need to prepare for the event.
additional.placeholder: Dinner info, hotel recommendations, parking, or other notes.

maxGuests.title: Maximum number of guests
maxGuests.description: Set the total guest cap for your event

plusOne.title: Allow +1 guests
plusOne.description: Let guests add a companion when confirming attendance

rsvpDeadline.title: RSVP Deadline
rsvpDeadline.description: The deadline by which a guest must confirm attendance

autoReminders.title: Automatic reminder sending
autoReminders.description: Guests who haven't responded yet will get a reminder 3 days before the deadline

step5.title: Choose your event experiences
step5.coreNote: Digital invitation, event info, and RSVP are core features and are available without activation.

invite.title: Digital Invitation
invite.description: Guests receive a mobile-optimized invitation with the event details.

info.title: Event Information
info.description: Event details, address, and other important information in one place.

rsvp.title: RSVP
rsvp.description: Guests can easily confirm their attendance at the event.

step5.optionalHint: Choose the extra features that will be available to guests on the event link.

eventCamera.title: Event Camera
eventCamera.description: Guests upload photos directly from the event link.

voiceGuestbook.title: Voice Guestbook
voiceGuestbook.description: Guests can leave voice greetings straight from their phone.

hiddenMoments.title: Hidden Moments
hiddenMoments.description: Photos stay hidden until 9:00 AM the next day to keep the surprise.

lettersFromRoom.title: Letters From the Room
lettersFromRoom.description: Interactive prompts and letters for guests during the event.

timeCapsule.title: Time Capsule
timeCapsule.description: Automatically archives and stores created content for years to come.

sharedGallery.title: Shared Gallery
sharedGallery.description: Guests can view and download photos taken by one another.

messageForLater.title: Message for Later
messageForLater.description: Guests can leave messages that get delivered at a later time.

guestSees.title: What the guest sees
guestSees.description: The digital invitation sent to the guest's phone and the experience available to them.

address.title: Address
address.value: Digital invitation sent to their phone

reception.title: Reception
reception.value: Guest sees it on their phone and confirms their status instantly

experience.title: Experience
experience.value: Photos, voice messages, and shared gallery

overview.title: Quick overview
overview.description: The guest sees the mobile invitation and the experience available to them.

activated.title: Activated experience
activated.description: The guest sees the mobile invitation and the experience available to them.

before.title: Ready to publish?
before.description: Click "Publish" to activate your invitation and generate a unique link.
